title: Crate Lift
reference: repeat 2 { F1 } def F1 { turn_left pick_up turn_right drop repeat 3 { jump } }
hints: Each ledge is two high. A crate makes it one step at a time.
F1: turn left, pick up the crate, turn back, drop it ahead, then jump three times (a repeat saves blocks). Main repeats F1.
repeat 2 { F1 } def F1 { turn_left pick_up turn_right drop repeat 3 { jump } }

story.outro: PATCH: "Building your own stairs. VANTA didn't plan for that."
